download_rep_convai2_label_model: download the rep_convai2_label dialogue unlikelihood model for ConvAI2 to the specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the rep_convai2_label_v1.tgz model archive into the data directory
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that calls build with model_type rep_convai2_label and version v1.0
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it delegates to the build helper for model retrieval
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the model archive is fetched
